risks.title: Dependence on volatile semiconductor industry demand
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned first in Item 3.D with direct language ('largely dependent', 'volatile'). Directly impacts royalty and licensing revenue. Stable trend but structural in nature. Major categorical weight for ARM.

risks.title: Intense competition from RISC-V and proprietary architectures
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed over 2+ pages with concrete examples (RISC-V joint venture August 2023, x86, proprietary architectures). High alert language ('intensely competitive', 'may choose'). Direct threat to business model. Upward trend.

risks.title: Risks associated with integrated product development (CSS, chiplets)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified as exposing ARM to 'new or enhanced competitive, brand, technological, regulatory and financial risks'. Moderate but clear cautionary language. New trend (CSS launched February 2024). Growing strategic weight.

risks.title: Revenue concentration among limited number of customers
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named 'A significant portion of our total revenue comes from a limited number of customers'. Direct language on elevated exposure. Mentioned twice in document. Stable trend but structural in nature.

risks.title: Dependence on Arm China for PRC market access
risks.score_rationale: Explicit geopolitical risk amid US/UK-PRC tensions. ARM does not control Arm China (operates independently). Moderate alert language ('could be materially and adversely affected'). Upward trend due to trade and national security tensions.

risks.title: Protection and defense of intellectual property rights
risks.score_rationale: IP risk explicitly detailed with litigation cost references. Moderate alert language ('Failure to obtain, maintain, protect'). Counterfeiting and defensive litigation risk mentioned. Stable trend but rising costs.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and unauthorized access to sensitive data
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity risk explicitly named ('possibility of cyberattacks, breaches of our security controls'). Includes customer data exposure. Moderate but direct language. Upward trend (rising sector threats). Growing weight for software/IP companies.

risks.title: Product compatibility with EDA tools and foundry manufacturing processes
risks.score_rationale: Specific technology risk explicitly mentioned ('compatibility with EDA tools and foundries manufacturing processes'). Moderate language ('if we fail to optimize'). Third-party dependencies (EDA vendors, foundries). Stable trend but rising complexity.

ai_positioning.summary: Arm positions itself as a leader in chip-scale AI adoption, with growing NPU core integration in processor designs for smartphones, IoT, and automobiles. Its technology ecosystem enables rapid deployment of AI features.
evidence: 10-K MD&A confirms: 'AI demand is driving strong momentum for the Arm ecosystem' with NPUs across smartphones, automobiles, and IoT
Development of pre-integrated subsystems (CSS) with AI IP mentioned in 10-K as key value driver
Strategic synergies with SoftBank on semiconductors and AI leveraged through CEO role expansion (Form 6-K April 2026)
